newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BRL Hardy okay with profit forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BRL Hardy okay with profit forecasts.

text.p: BRL Hardy Ltd, Australia's second largest wine producer, said on Monday it was not uncomfortable with analysts' forecasts for a rise in net profit before abnormal items of up to 20 percent for calendar year 1996.

"Most of the analysts have got forecasts in the market place that have said our results could be up as much as 20 percent on last year and we are not uncomfortable with their forecasts," BRL managing director Stephen Millar told Reuters.
"It has been a very good year, the whole Australian wine industry is doing well," he said.
BRL Hardy reported a net profit of A$17.4 million in 1995.
The 1996 results are due to be released on March 6.
